purpose: General prospective fixes for observed context exhaustion and setup admission stops; no notebook-specific scientific code.

context_recovery.reuse: Existing explicit context restart used after provider HTTP400; extend it to received length responses in shell-enabled tool sessions.
context_recovery.retained: Original system/user input, latest complete artifact/revision chain, full raw trace, live workspace, request ledger and absolute deadline.
context_recovery.guards: Never execute a partial response. No restart when the conversation cannot shrink, a turn is unavailable, no notice is supplied, or the interface is not shell/tool enabled. No new token, byte or request caps.

setup_time_admission.reuse: Existing OperationBudgetExceeded certifies refusal before dispatch. Only environment setup may retry that refused request with a shorter timeout.
setup_time_admission.bounds: Effective timeout does not exceed the configured setup maximum or available absolute time minus the existing return allowance of 55 seconds. Scientific reference, solver and verifier timeouts are unchanged.
setup_time_admission.guards: An uncertain dispatched command or ordinary setup failure is never retried by this mechanism. Preserve the setup-admission receipt in full and bounded diagnostics.

tests.overlap: The 85 focused transport tests are included in the broader selection of 231 tests; the other 132 tests are disjoint.

code_quality: Ruff/format for root and explicit experimental files, ty and required pre-commit all pass.
recorded_conversation: recorded-conversation-check.json: the archived conversation with 90 messages reduced to 3 while preserving the original first 2. No new model call, deleted-sandbox recovery or reduced token-count measurement.
